shortest.program: bipartisan(V0) <= party(V1, V2) & supports(V0, V1) & supports(V0, V3) & ~party(V3, V2)

in_cycle(V0) <= inv1(V1, V0) & requires(V0, V1)
inv1(V0, V1) <= inv1(V0, V2) & requires(V2, V1)
inv1(V0, V1) <= requires(V0, V1)
released(V0) <= (V1 != V2) & (V1 != V3) & (V2 != V3) & approves(V0, V1) & approves(V0, V2) & owner(V0, V3)

state(V0, down) <= ping(V0, fail) & polled(V0) & ~ping(V0, ok)
state(V0, flapping) <= ping(V0, fail) & ping(V0, ok)
state(V0, silent) <= polled(V0) & ~ping(V0, fail) & ~ping(V0, ok)
state(V0, up) <= ping(V0, ok) & polled(V0) & ~ping(V0, fail)

recalibrate(V0) <= reading(V1, V0) & ~calibrated(V0)
trusted(V0) <= calibrated(V1) & reading(V0, V1)
